from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single company's quarterly filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="Period end date in YYYY-MM format")
    
    revenue_amount: float | None = Field(description="Reported revenue figure")
    revenue_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the revenue figure (e.g. million, thousand, billion)")
    
    net_income_amount: float | None = Field(description="Consolidated Net Income (positive for income, negative for loss)")
    net_income_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the net income figure (e.g. million, thousand, billion)")
    
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total Shareholders' Equity (negative if deficit)")
    equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the equity figure (e.g. million, thousand, billion)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_snapshots: list[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
